text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Just one more step... I feel.
"Cute is the strongest"... Duramente seems to still be struggling relentlessly to acquire "cuteness."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Aren't you overthinking things a bit?
While the two of us were deep in thought, Satono Crown, who happened to be passing by, joined our conversation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Daanhai ne... Overthinking isn't good either, you know. For now, how about taking a breather?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Let's see... If you're searching for cuteness—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hou hooi! Look, cuteness has gathered all around us, from the shop to the menu!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
............
Indeed, everything is cute...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I understand what "cute" is. I understand, but... it makes me wonder all over again.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Why... is cute the "strongest"?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Just as Goo-nee says, when faced with cuteness... why does one feel as if all the strength drains from their body?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Aiyaa, brooding over it again... First, let's just eat something sweet! They have delicious parfaits here.
Adorable heart- and star-shaped toppings, and sweetness spreading throughout the mouth. While savoring that taste thoroughly on the tongue—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, forgive me. It's just... eating such a cute parfait made Duramente-san smile so cutely.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Somehow, watching that made me... Fufu.
Gazing at Satono Crown's smile, Duramente shifts her eyes down to the empty parfait glass.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see. This atmosphere, this... sensation.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Is this... the power to bring happiness to others?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I see... It truly is the strongest, then.
Duramente seems to have found a satisfying answer, and Satono Crown smiles in relief. Seeing them laugh together—
choice_data_list: Would you two like seconds on parfait?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: What, do you wish to see her stuff her cheeks like a squirrel? Granted, that would be an adorable sight, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No, yeah. It might suit you. Once the refill arrives, I shall feed you myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Wait, you intend to make me stuff my cheeks?!
Duramente excitedly waits for the refill to arrive.
It might just be the very definition of cuteness. When I mention that, Satono Crown makes a troubled face.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Perhaps. ...Though always keeping a smile on your face is quite a difficult thing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, indeed. Crown is right.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No... I see. Because it is difficult, mastering it might just make one the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Let us give it a try.
Looking at Duramente's dead-serious expression, Satono Crown and I couldn't help but burst into laughter together.
